prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: original transparent pixel-art game drone sprite master for a WorkAdventure technology-event plaza. Create ONE cohesive sprite sheet, exactly 4 equal columns by 3 equal rows in a 4:3 canvas. Every cell contains the SAME compact cinematic CAMERA QUAD DRONE in consistent scale and orthographic RPG three-quarter/top-down viewpoint. Four enclosed circular ducted rotors, a chunky large dark gimbal camera lens, charcoal-and-ivory body, tiny steady cyan status accent. DISTINCT silhouette from a generic open-prop quadcopter. Columns face south, east, north, west respectively. Rows are THREE different clearly visible rotor phases, same body and camera, no translation within cells. Crisp intentional premium pixel-game rendering, controlled shading, mechanical detail, no cartoony face. Each drone isolated centered in its cell with at least 15% completely transparent padding, nothing touches neighboring cells. Actual transparent alpha background. No shadows outside the drone, no glow halo, no motion trails, no grid, no labels, no lettering, no watermark, no scenery. Designed to downsample with nearest neighbor to a legible 24 by 24 pixel bounding box; prioritize strong body/duct/lens shapes over tiny texture. Make the three rotor phases visible as changed pale blade spokes within dark duct rings.
